supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: pronounced extension beyond the outer 2D boundary of the eye corners

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: muzzle region exhibits high-intensity lightness compared to the low-intensity dark periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thick with a moderate structural droop of the lower lip

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: small reddish lesion or mark visible on the mid-forehead at the hair-skin boundary
